title: A Horizon for the Landfall
author: Wren Villalobos
blurb: Elodie Zhou, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
